context:
Goal: trial run gd finishes.
Problem (rule): the run is stopped on a permission prompt that only you can answer, and the prompt is a false alarm.
Based on (read): the reviewer's command only passes test strings to the guard; one string looks like a settings file that raises the agent model to Opus.
Departs from: today the run waits on the prompt — Deny lets it go on, with the reviewer testing another way.

options.gain: The run goes on, and the reviewer runs its test another way.
options.how: Open trial run gd and press Deny on the waiting prompt.
options.label: Press Deny

options.gain: The run goes on with its test as written.
options.how: Open trial run gd and press Allow.
options.label: Press Allow
options.lose: It writes nothing, but it counts as your approval to lift the agent model cap.

reply: Closed 13:05 CST, no answer needed: trial run gd is archived, so its prompt no longer waits. The false alarm stays on step agent-model-cap-string-false-alarm.
title: Press Deny on the stuck permission prompt in trial run gd
why: Trial run gd has waited on a permission prompt since 01:16 CST. A reviewer fed test text into a guard, and the guard that caps agent models read one test string as a real settings change and asked. Nothing writes settings. Only you can answer a prompt in another session.
